name: IRIS/TESSA V3 Oracle-Z Representation Court V2
research_question: When perception is bypassed and scene state is optimized directly, which part of the current Z -> Q(Z,x) design limits continuous surface evidence: carrier representation, shared query capacity, optimization, or target spatial frequency?
hypothesis: A triplane carrier is not an obvious blocker for RealSaS surface-structured evidence if a calibrated per-scene upper-bound decoder can fit the relevant surface truth, a shared Q retains a bounded generalization gap, and the same court demonstrably distinguishes a dense 3-D carrier on an easier genuinely volumetric control.
